question: The Loss Arc of Anime Season 4 was an anime filled with incredible moments no matter what you looked at, but what really struck me was the title that appears at the very end. The original story already had so many great titles, so I imagine it must have been difficult to choose which ones to use for the anime. How did you decide?
answer:
This was difficult, wasn't it! (laughs) Of course, we also decide the titles for each episode during the script meetings. But because of the way Re:Zero works as an anime, the title appears right at the very end, which makes it difficult to use, for example, the title of something that happened in Part A. I want the title to appear with a big BAM! at the exact moment the episode ends, so that viewers go, “Whoa!”

There was even one episode where both Part A and Part B had such good material that we did something like a forbidden move and put one subtitle at the end of Part A and another one at the end of the episode. (laughs)

As you can probably tell, there weren't many episodes in the 《Loss Arc》 that ended on a satisfying note at the end of Part A, so we couldn't use that forbidden move. As a result, it became more like a process of choosing one title at a time from among the things that happened in Part B. After discussing them and putting a great deal of effort into refining the choices, we decide which ones make the cut.

As a result, the episode named after Meili ended up being left out. Even I was really surprised when I looked back on it. (laughs)

I feel like we might be able to work in another episode named after Meili somewhere in Chapter 10, so I hope you'll look forward to that.
